Hi Liam / Sofia —

Thanks again for the call earlier — really appreciated the clarity on your performance targets and the integration constraints. Quick recap of what I heard:

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for recall-heavy ranking pipeline and keep p95 latency under 250ms for user-facing queries.
- Data: on-prem vector store, requests proxied through your gateway (no PII in requests).
- Constraints: need SOC2 evidence and a plan for KV cache persistence across restarts.

Next step: schedule a technical deep-dive (60–90 minutes) with our ML/Infra engineers to:

1) Walk through ClearRoute's current inference flow and sample traces
2) Show Redwood's serving runtime + KV cache approach and fallbacks
3) Discuss integration patterns (on-prem proxy, network policies, and data handling)
4) Agree on a mutual action plan and required artifacts for security review

Suggested slots (PDT):
- Tue Jul 13, 9:00–10:30 AM
- Thu Jul 15, 10:00–11:30 AM

Please let me know which works (or share a couple of alternatives). If helpful, I can include our ML lead (Karthik Iyer) and solutions engineer (Jonas Weber) — they will drive the technical agenda. I attached a short TDX prep checklist and an initial mutual action plan.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,

We'll let Karthik walk through the exact network diagrams in the session.

- 30–55m: Redwood runtime deep-dive: KV cache, batching, fallbacks (Karthik)
- 55–70m: Integration patterns + security artifacts (Jonas)
- 70–75m: Next steps & mutual action plan alignment

If that looks good, I will send a calendar invite with the confirmed slot and include the TDX prep doc.

Thanks — cc'd Karthik and Jonas so they see the ask.
